SCREENPILOT SYNTHETIC CV FIXTURE
This document describes a fictional candidate created only for deterministic demo testing.

Casey Lumen
Product developer with Full Stack interest
Remote within Europe

PROFILE
Four years of fictional experience moving between workflow interfaces and supporting server-side services. Casey describes the desired direction as Full Stack. That wording must be recorded honestly, while the demo still explains that only Frontend Developer and Backend Developer are confirmed openings.

RECENT RESPONSIBILITIES
Delivered responsive interface changes, maintained a small set of product-service endpoints, and coordinated release notes for a distributed team. Worked with product and design to clarify user journeys, then collaborated with service-focused teammates when the same workflow required data changes. Participated in code review and lightweight agile planning without acting as a hiring assessor or technical interviewer.

PROJECT HIGHLIGHT
Owned a fictional internal request-tracking flow spanning a browser form, status view, and supporting service behavior. The useful recruiter-level fact is breadth of responsibility, not implementation depth. No real company, client, or user data is represented.

PREFERENCES
Interested in mixed responsibilities, learning across product boundaries, and a team that combines focused independent work with close collaboration. If Full Stack remains preferred, the screening must ask whether Frontend, Backend, both, or a general engineering discussion should anchor the call. Availability and compensation are not supplied.
